oracle-l5r-3426: Honor Never Falls (Forgotten Legacy). Its Focus Effect "Delay all consequences of losing this duel (from any source) until the end of the turn" is now BUILDABLE on the shared delay mechanism (src/L5R.Core/EmperorRulingR2.cs): DelayUntil.EndOfTurn is the trigger, and the duel's delay (EmperorRulingR2Cards.cs, WithDuelLossDelays) records every effect the duel's outcome applies to the loser's unit; "from any source" additionally needs the same scope wrapped around the OTHER Focus Effects that hit the loser (ContinueDuelFocusEffects/ResolveFocusEffectChoiceCommand call ApplyDuelFocusEffect outside the scope today) -- one wrapper per call. NOT wired, for two other reasons: (1) NO LOCAL SCAN (assets/reference/oracle/forgotten-legacy has receipts only, no webp), so the printed text could not be verified and the card cannot be packaged (build_definition_fields needs the scan and its receipt); (2) its Battle half "you may take an additional Battle action to use one of his base abilities" has no exact shape: AdditionalActionGrant.ScopeCardIds scopes a grant to a source CARD, so an ability granted to him could consume it; a scope limited to his printed (base) abilities does not exist.
oracle-l5r-10258: Kurohito's Perfection (Torn Asunder): "When paying the cost of the rulebook Favor Political Limited action: You may ignore the cost of discarding a card; if you did, delay its effects until your End Phase begins." NO LOCAL SCAN (assets/reference/oracle/torn-asunder has receipts only), so it is not wired or published. The trigger point exists (DelayUntil.EndPhaseBegins, applied by SetPhase(Phase.End)) but this delays a WHOLE action's effects -- the Favor action's Honor, Gold, draw and Imperial Favor changes as well as card effects -- and the recording layer captures only effects on a card (bow, straighten, dishonor, destroy, move, modifiers, tokens, keyword and ability grants). It needs a whole-action capture (every effect the rulebook Favor action applies, on cards AND players, recorded as closures and replayed in order), plus the alternative cost (ignore the discard) tied to the choice; the rulebook Favor action has no AbilityDefinition, so its effects would have to be recorded where the universal command runs.
